name: Azimuthal Hit Detection
definition: Determines whether an azimuthal hit occurs for a given ray. An azimuthal hit is an intersection with the ray and an azimuthal section, where azimuthal sections live in the XZ plane.
summary: Azimuthal Hit Detection determines ray intersections with azimuthal sections in spherical voxel grids, leveraging planar XZ geometry to efficiently handle angular discretization unlike axis-aligned or tetrahedral methods.
